AccountAddParams.description:
`account.add` params. The account JSON carries credentials, which is why the method is
only accepted on the parent's stdin.

account.description:
The account JSON `sync` mode reads from `--account` or stdin. Without an `id` the
engine derives one (`ACCOUNT_ID_SETTINGS`).

identity.description:
The identity line `sync` mode reads: a Tern server object, a Mailspring identity
(ignored) or null. Null uses the server `server.set` stored, if any.

secrets.description: Secrets to store with the account, in place of any in its `settings`.

test.description:
Run `account.test` first and add the account only when it passes; a failure is
`code::ACCOUNT_TEST_FAILED` with the test's result.

AccountAddParams.title: AccountAddParams

AccountAddResult.description:
`account.add` result: the account's state when the call returns, `running` once its
`main` thread is up, `stopped` (with `error`) when it failed to start.

stored.description:
The account and its secrets are in the engine's registry and secret store, so the
client need not keep them (`feature::ACCOUNTS`). False
when no secret store could take them: the engine runs the account until it exits.

AccountAddResult.title: AccountAddResult

provider.description:
The provider preset the user picked: `imap` (default), `gmail`, `office365`,
`outlook`, `yahoo`, `icloud`, `fastmail`, …

account.description:
`{emailAddress, provider, settings}`: hosts, ports, usernames, security,
`*_allow_insecure_ssl` and `container_folder`. Security is never `none`. An empty
`imap_host` means nothing was found that offers IMAP; the client asks for the servers.

source.description: `matcher`, `autoconfig`, `provider-table` or `fallback` (the `imap.<domain>` guess).

template.description: The table entry used, when one was.

error.description: The `SyncError` JSON that stopped the account, when `state` is `stopped`.

AccountJson.description:
The account JSON without secrets, as `account.list`, `account.changed` and the account
methods return it. On a relayed connection only the fields
`public_account_json` keeps.

settings.description: IMAP and SMTP settings; never the passwords or the refresh token.

AccountJson.title: AccountJson

deleteData.description: Delete the account's rows from the database, plugin metadata included.

revoke.description: Revoke the account's OAuth grant at the provider (Google; Microsoft has no such call).

stillRunning.description:
The names of the account's threads still running after the stop timeout, left to
finish a blocking call (e.g. `background`). Empty when every thread exited.

AccountReorderParams.description:
`account.reorder` params: account ids in the order `account.list` returns them. Ids not
named keep their order after the named ones.
AccountReorderParams.title: AccountReorderParams

AccountResetParams.description:
`account.reset` params. `keepMetadata` (default true) keeps the account's plugin metadata
for the resync; a client removing the account passes false so it goes with the rest.
AccountResetParams.title: AccountResetParams

AccountSecrets.description:
An account's secrets, under the `settings` keys they replace. Write-only: no method
returns them.
AccountSecrets.title: AccountSecrets

AccountSetSecretsParams.description:
`account.setSecrets` params: new credentials for a registered account (reconnect). The
account restarts with them.
AccountSetSecretsParams.title: AccountSetSecretsParams

imap_allow_cleartext.description: The host the user confirmed `none` for.

imap_password.description: Only in what a client sends (`account.add`, `account.test`); never returned.

authFailed.description:
With `stopped`: the server refused the credentials. The engine doesn't retry; new
credentials (`account.add`) do.

error.description: The `SyncError` JSON, with `stopped`.

retryAt.description:
With `stopped`: when the engine starts the account again (Unix milliseconds). Absent
once it gave up (too many failures in a row) or the credentials were refused.

account.description:
The account JSON without its secrets: on a local connection everything but the
passwords and refresh token; on a relayed one only the fields
`public_account_json` lists.

connectionError.description: The last `ProcessState` the account sent: true while it cannot reach its server.

error.description: The `SyncError` JSON that stopped the account, when `state` is `stopped`.

AccountTestParams.description:
`account.test` params: the account JSON with its credentials in `settings` or in
`secrets`.
AccountTestParams.title: AccountTestParams

AccountTestResult.description:
`account.test`'s result, `--mode test`'s object: `account` (with any rotated refresh
token, on stdin only) on success, `error` (an `ErrorCodeToTypeMap` name) and `log` on
failure.

error_advice.description: After a TLS failure: what the user can change.

error_offline.description: The OAuth refresh failed because the network is down.

AccountTestResult.title: AccountTestResult

AccountUpdateParams.description:
`account.update` params. `patch` holds top-level Account fields to replace and a
`settings` object whose keys replace the account's (null removes one). Secrets and `id`
can't be patched. Changing where the account connects (host, port, username, security,
provider or OAuth client) deletes its stored secrets, so they can't be sent to the new
server; the account stays stopped until `account.setSecrets`.
AccountUpdateParams.title: AccountUpdateParams

restarted.description: The running account restarted with the new settings.

secretsCleared.description: The stored secrets were deleted: send new ones with `account.setSecrets`.

DraftBodies.description: What a client's send hooks made of the body (`applyTransformsForSending`).

perRecipient.description: Recipient address to the body that recipient gets.

self.description: The body that goes out, and is saved to Sent.

DraftBodies.title: DraftBodies

cancelled.description: False when there was nothing to cancel: no pending send, or it has started.

accountId.description:
The account to write from: for `new`, `mailto` and `resurface`; a reply or forward is
written from the message's account. Without it, `core.sending.defaultAccountIdForSend`
or else the first account.

attach.description:
Files to attach, as `DraftUpdateParams::attach`. With `save: false` too: the engine
keeps the copies, and the draft's `files` carries them.

behavior.description:
`reply`, `reply-all`: `prefer-existing` answers with the newest draft already replying
to the message (its recipients switched to the kind, then `fields` over it, `hMsgId`
aside), `prefer-existing-if-pristine` only when that draft is untouched. Without it a
new draft is made.

body.description: `resurface`: the body; the `resurfacing.snoozeBody` setting's by default.

fields.description:
Message JSON keys set over what the kind builds: `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `from` (contact
lists), `subject`, `body`, `files`, `threadId`, `hMsgId`, `rthMsgId`, `fwdMsgId`,
`plaintext`, `pristine`; `aid` for `new`. A draft the engine saves (`save` not false)
is not pristine when these set any recipients, subject, body or files, unless they
set `pristine` themselves.

messageId.description:
`reply`, `reply-all`, `forward`: the message (its id); `resurface`: the message it
answers, else the thread's newest.

save.description:
False: answer with the draft without saving it (a client that saves it itself after
its own hooks). True by default.

template.description:
A template's name (`feature::TEMPLATES`), applied after
`fields` as the desktop inserts one: its body replaces the text above the signature
and quote, and its subject is the draft's unless `fields` has a `subject` or the draft
is a reply or forward.

tz.description: The IANA zone for dates in quotes; the engine's zone by default.

DraftDeleteParams.description:
`draft.delete`: queues a `DestroyDraftTask`. A send-later pending on the draft (an undo
window or a schedule) is cancelled in the same transaction, so the expiration executor
sends it wholly before or not at all; a draft whose `SendDraftTask` is queued can't be
deleted.
DraftDeleteParams.title: DraftDeleteParams

cancelledSend.description: A pending send-later was cancelled with the draft.

delayMs.description:
The undo window. Without it (or 0) the draft is sent now; with it the engine writes
send-later metadata (`isUndoSend`) and sends when it is due, also after a restart.

scheduledAt.description: Unix seconds, when the send waits out the undo window.

DraftUpdateParams.description:
`draft.update`: an edit to a stored draft, refused while it is being sent or has a
send-later (an undo window or a schedule) pending. Answers with the saved draft's Message
JSON and its `body`.

attach.description:
Absolute paths of files on the engine's machine to attach, after `fields`. The engine
copies each into its files directory as a new File, named after the path and typed by
its extension; a file the draft already carries with the same name and bytes isn't
attached twice. Local clients only (`policy`).

detach.description:
Files to remove, after `attach`: a File id, or a filename that names one of the
draft's files. An upload's copy (a File with no `messageId`) is deleted with it.

fields.description:
Message JSON keys set over the stored draft, as `DraftCreateParams::fields` are over
a built one; `aid` and `hMsgId` stay. The draft is no longer pristine when these, or
`attach` or `detach`, write recipients, subject, body or files, unless they set
`pristine` themselves.

DraftUpdateParams.title: DraftUpdateParams

skipSalutationFor.description:
Recipients whose names aren't checked against the salutation (the desktop's "Send &
Ignore Warnings For This Email").

excludeIcsuid.description: The invitation being answered, left out of its own conflicts.

queue.description:

timezone.description: The zone the times are written in; UTC when absent.

EventsExpandParams.description:
`events.expand`: the occurrences of stored events that overlap `[start, end]`, or of an
ICS that is not stored (`ics`, an emailed invitation). Rows are chosen by `eventIds`,
else `calendarIds`, else every calendar of `accountIds` (every account by default); an
event id brings every row of its UID.

conflicts.description:
Also answer `conflicts`: the timed occurrences of the chosen rows that overlap
`[start, end)` and that the account attends.

focus.description:
With `eventIds`: also answer `focused`, the occurrence to show for an event opened
from outside the calendar. With `ics`: also answer `upcoming` and `first`.

ics.description:
An ICS to expand instead of stored rows, read as the account `accountIds` names
first would have it.

EventsExpandResult.description:
`events.expand`'s answer. An occurrence has the desktop's `EventOccurrence` keys
(`id`, `eventId`, `accountId`, `calendarId`, `title`, `start`, `end`, `startDate`,
`endDate` as days since 1970-01-01, `isAllDay`, `isRecurring`, `isException`,
`recurrenceIdStart`, `organizer`, `attendees`, `isMine`, `myStatus`, ...).

first.description:
With `ics` and `focus`: the invitation's own times, from its first VEVENT, in the
same shape; `recurrenceId` when it is about one occurrence of a series.

truncated.description:
More occurrences overlap the window than one reply carries
(`EVENTS_EXPAND_MAX_OCCURRENCES`); ask for a narrower one.

upcoming.description: `{start, end, isAllDay, recurrenceId?}`; null once a series is over.

EventsExpandResult.title: EventsExpandResult

now.description: The time to look forward from.

recurrenceIdStart.description: The occurrence to focus, by the slot it fills.

EventsRsvpParams.description:
`events.rsvp`: our answer to an invitation, on our copy (`eventId`) or on an emailed
one (`ics`, with `messageId`), written to our copy and emailed to the organizer as a
REPLY; or, with `counter`, a COUNTER proposing another time, with nothing written.

calendarId.description:
With `ics` and no stored copy: the calendar to add it to when attending; the
account's first writable calendar by default.

messageId.description: The message the invitation came in; the REPLY answers it.

occurrenceStart.description: The one occurrence of a series to answer, by the slot it fills.

reply.description: False: don't email the organizer. True by default.

retried.description:
Set on an answer made again on a copy that changed under the first; not retried a
second time.

subject.description: The subject; `Accepted: <title>` (or `New time proposed: <title>`) by default.

write.description: False: don't write our copy. True by default.

EventsRsvpParams.title: EventsRsvpParams

email.description: Our address on the guest list.

EventsUpdateParams.description:
`events.update`: `patch` on one occurrence, that one and the ones after, or the whole
series. On an event that does not repeat every scope is `all`.

occurrenceStart.description:
For `this` and `following`: the occurrence, by the slot it fills (its
`recurrenceIdStart`, else its start). Not needed for an exception row.

patch.description:
`start`, `end`, `isAllDay`, `timezone`, `summary`, `location`, `description`,
`attendees` (`[{email, name?, role?}]`, the whole list), `transparency`,
`recurrenceRule` (null removes it), `deleted: true` (removes the occurrences the
scope covers).

notifiesGuests.description:

calendar server mails them the change or cancellation (RFC 6638 section 3.2.1).

account.add.description:
`serve` mode: register an account, store its secrets and start syncing it
(`AccountAddParams`). On the parent's stdin, and on the
socket of an engine with `feature::ACCOUNT_SETUP`
(local-only class, `policy`).

account.discover.description:
IMAP and SMTP settings for an address (`AccountDiscoverParams`).
Open to relayed connections; answered out of order (MX and autoconfig lookups).

account.list.description: Every account the engine holds, with its state.

account.oauth.begin.description:
Starts an OAuth sign-in: the engine keeps the PKCE verifier, `state` and client
secret (`OAuthBeginParams`).

account.oauth.complete.description:
Ends it with the redirect's `code` and `state`: exchange, profile, discovery, test,
then the account is stored and started (`OAuthCompleteParams`).
Answered out of order.

account.remove.description:
`serve` mode: stop an account, unregister it and delete its secrets, with `revoke`
also its OAuth grant and with `deleteData` its rows
(`AccountRemoveParams`). Without `deleteData` the rows
stay. Where `account.add` is taken.

account.reset.description:
`serve` mode: stop the account if the engine holds it, delete its rows from the
database (`--mode reset`) and start it again from the registry to resync (a client
that adds it again gets ACCOUNT_EXISTS). Where `account.add` is taken; answered out of
order.

account.setSecrets.description: New credentials for a registered account (`AccountSetSecretsParams`).

account.test.description:
`serve` mode: check an account's IMAP and SMTP settings, as `--mode test` does
(`AccountTestParams`). The result is that mode's JSON
object, with any rotated refresh token in its `account` on stdin only. Where
`account.add` is taken; answered out of order.

account.update.description:
Changes an account's JSON (`AccountUpdateParams`).
Relayed devices without the admin scope may change only
`ACCOUNT_DISPLAY_FIELDS`.

ai.cancel.description: Answered at once, in order: stops the calling connection's stream `streamId`.

ai.models.description:
The `ai.*` methods (`feature::AI`), params and results
in `crate::AiSettings`. Until the engine keeps the AI
settings and keys, local clients send the provider `config`, key included, and the
`settings` with each call; a relayed connection may send neither
(`policy`). Answered out of order on the engine's AI workers (T21);
a failed model call is `code::AI_FAILED`.

ai.usage.description: Token counts per day, provider and feature since the engine started.

contacts.update.description: An edit to a contact, params `ContactsUpdateParams`.

credentials.import.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: register accounts and store secrets a client
held until now, params
`CredentialsImportParams`.

draft.cancelSend.description:
Cancels a send waiting out its undo window, params
`DraftCancelSendParams`.

draft.create.description:
Builds a draft as the desktop does and saves it
(`feature::DRAFT_PIPELINE`), params
`DraftCreateParams`; answers with its Message JSON.

draft.send.description:
Sends a draft now or after an undo window, params
`DraftSendParams`.

draft.update.description:
An edit to a stored draft (`feature::DRAFT_EDITING`),
params `DraftUpdateParams`; answers with its Message JSON.

draft.validate.description: The checks before a send, params `DraftValidateParams`.

engine.logs.tail.description: The end of an account's log, or of the engine's own log.

engine.resetDatabase.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: stop and forget every account, delete the
database and create an empty one. The client adds the accounts again.

engine.setLogLevel.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: verbose protocol logging until a time, for
every account; running accounts restart to pick it up.

engine.shutdown.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only (the socket too on a `--detached` engine): stop
every account, remove the socket files and exit 0.

events.expand.description:
Occurrences of stored events or of an ICS
(`feature::CALENDAR_EDITING`), params
`EventsExpandParams`.

events.rsvp.description:
An answer to an invitation or a counter-proposal, params
`EventsRsvpParams`.

events.update.description:
An edit to an event or some of its occurrences, params
`EventsUpdateParams`.

files.get.description:
A File by id, downloaded first when missing (`feature::FILES`),
params `FilesGetParams`. Local clients only; answered out of
order while it waits for the download.

files.put.description: Stores bytes as a new File for a draft, params `FilesPutParams`.

files.read.description: A chunk of a downloaded File, params `FilesReadParams`.

integrations.translate.description:
The `integrations.*` methods (`feature::INTEGRATIONS`).
Each carries the
provider's `config`, key included, until the engine owns the credentials. Local
clients only, answered out of order on the engine's integrations workers (T21); a
provider failure is `code::INTEGRATION_FAILED`.

messages.unsubscribe.description:
Unsubscribes from the list a message came from
(`feature::UNSUBSCRIBE`), params
`MessagesUnsubscribeParams`. Socket only; answered
out of order while a one-click POST runs.

metadata.list.description:
Messages or threads carrying a plugin's metadata
(`feature::METADATA_LIST`).

query.description: A ModelQuery over the stored models (`feature::QUERY`).

rules.reprocess.description:
Mail rules (`feature::RULES`): params and results in
`crate::RulesReprocessParams` and `crate::RulesCancelParams`. The rules themselves
are the `mailRules` setting.

secrets.has.description: Which of the named secrets are stored (`SecretsHasParams`).

secrets.set.description:
Stores a secret that isn't an account's (`SecretsSetParams`).
There is no `secrets.get`.

server.clear.description: Forgets it and its token; accounts sync metadata locally.

server.set.description: The Tern server the accounts sync metadata with (`ServerSetParams`).

settings.get.description:
The stored engine-owned settings (`feature::SETTINGS`),
params `SettingsGetParams`, result
`SettingsValues`.

tasks.list.description: Stored tasks by account, status, class or draft (`feature::TASKS_LIST`).

templates.delete.description:
Deletes a template's file, params `TemplateNameParams`.
Local clients only.

templates.get.description:
One template with its body, params `TemplateNameParams`,
result `TemplateResult`.

templates.save.description:
Saves a template, params `TemplateSaveParams`, result
`TemplateResult`. Local clients only.

test.crash.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only, debug builds only: stop one account as a
fatal error would (`test-crash` on stdin in `sync` mode).

test.panic.description: As `TEST_CRASH`, with a panic on the account's `main` thread.

threads.snooze.description:
Moves threads to Snoozed with the metadata that brings them back
(`feature::SNOOZE`), params
`ThreadsSnoozeParams`.

account.changed.description:
Notification: an account's registered JSON changed, `params` =
`AccountChangedParams`. Filtered by account, never held
for a later subscriber: a client calls `account.list` after `subscribe`.

ai.delta.description:
Notification: the next piece of a streamed answer, `params` =
`AiDeltaParams`. Sent only to the connection that started the
stream, in order, without `subscribe`; the call's response comes after the last one
and carries the whole text.

ai.triage.progress.description: Notification: triage progress for the connection that called `ai.triage.run`.

capabilities.changed.description:
Notification: the engine's `capabilities` changed (`feature::CAPABILITIES`),
`params` = the new capabilities object, whole. Sent to every subscribed connection
whatever its filter, never held for a later subscriber: `hello` and `engine.status`
carry the current value.

disconnect.description:
Notification: the engine is about to close the connection, `params` =
`DisconnectParams`.

mail.new.description:
Notification: new mail, `params` = `MailNewParams`. Filtered by
account only, never held for a later subscriber (`feature::MAIL_NEW`).

rules.disabled.description:
Notification: the engine disabled a failing rule. Sent to every subscribed connection
whatever its filter, never held: the rule's `disabled` and `disabledReason` are saved in
`mailRules`, and `settings.changed` carries them as well.

rules.progress.description:
Notification: a `rules.reprocess` job's progress, to the connection that started it
only, without `subscribe`; never held.

settings.changed.description:
Notification: settings another connection (or the parent) changed, `params` =
`SettingsValues` with the new values, null for a cleared key.
Sent to every subscribed connection whatever its filter, never held for a later
subscriber: a client calls `settings.get` after `subscribe`.

RulesCancelParams.description: `rules.cancel`: stops a `rules.reprocess` job before its next batch of threads.
RulesCancelParams.title: RulesCancelParams

cancelled.description: False when no such job was running.

RulesDisabledParams.description:

connection: the engine disabled a rule that failed. The rule's `disabled` and
`disabledReason` are in `mailRules` too, so a client that missed this reads them there.
RulesDisabledParams.title: RulesDisabledParams

RulesProgressParams.description:
Notification `method::RULES_PROGRESS`, to the connection

stopped.description: The job ended after `done` threads: it was cancelled or the account stopped.

RulesReprocessParams.description:

threads first.
RulesReprocessParams.title: RulesReprocessParams

whitespace-separated term must match, and nothing in it is read as FTS syntax. With
`grammar: true` (feature `search-grammar`) it is the search grammar, its date terms read
in `tz` (an IANA name, UTC when absent) and counted back from `now` (unix seconds; needed
only by relative dates); text that doesn't parse, or a date outside the documented
subset, is `INVALID_PARAMS`. The threads are `accountId`'s, or `accounts`' (feature
`search-grammar`), or, with neither, every account's the engine holds.

code.description: The line is not JSON. The response's `id` is null.
code.name: PARSE_ERROR

code.description: JSON, but not a request object.
code.name: INVALID_REQUEST

code.description:
`hello` named a protocol version the engine does not speak; `data.supported` lists
the ones it does.
code.name: UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL

code.description: The `accountId` is not one the engine holds.
code.name: UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT

code.description: The task's local phase failed; `data` is the `SyncError` JSON.
code.name: TASK_REJECTED

code.description: A request other than `hello` came before a successful `hello`.
code.name: HELLO_REQUIRED

code.description: A read named a folder, label, thread or message the account does not have.
code.name: NOT_FOUND

code.description:
The account is known but not running (it stopped on an error, or is being
removed); `data` is `{state, error}`.
code.name: ACCOUNT_STOPPED

code.description: `account.add` named an account that is already starting or running.
code.name: ACCOUNT_EXISTS

code.description:
The method is only accepted on the parent's stdin (`credentials.import`,
`engine.shutdown`, ...), or only on the socket (`subscribe`).
code.name: WRONG_CHANNEL

code.description:
A relayed connection asked for a method or task its device's scopes don't allow
(`policy`).
code.name: FORBIDDEN_RELAYED

code.description: The engine already has as many socket connections as it accepts.
code.name: TOO_MANY_CONNECTIONS

code.description:
"Integration failed": a provider call failed; `data` is the serialized
`IntegrationError` `{key, message, retryable, status?, retryAfter?}`.
code.name: INTEGRATION_FAILED

code.description:
"AI request failed": a model call failed or the account or feature is off; `data`
is the serialized `AiError` `{key, message, retryable, status?, retryAfter?}`.
code.name: AI_FAILED

code.description:
The engine's workers for this kind of call are all busy and their queue is full; the
client may try again later.
code.name: ENGINE_BUSY

code.description:
"Account test failed": `account.add {test}`, `account.setSecrets {test}` or
`account.oauth.complete` found the settings or credentials don't work; `data` is the
`account.test` result (`error`, `error_service`, `log`, ...).
code.name: ACCOUNT_TEST_FAILED

code.description:
"OAuth sign-in failed": the code exchange or the profile request failed, or the
account has no mailbox; `data` is `{key, status?, providerError?}`.
code.name: OAUTH_FAILED

reminders); `threadId`, and `messageId` for the message it answers.

The search grammar (`from:`, `in:`, `is:`, `has:attachment`, `before:`/`after:`,
`AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, parentheses) in `query.search {grammar: true, tz, now}` and in
`search {grammar: true, tz, now}`, and `search {accounts}`.

`hello.relayed`: the engine applies `policy` to relayed
connections. `tern-gateway` refuses to relay to an engine without it, which would
ignore the field.

feature.description: `settings.get`, `settings.set` and `settings.changed`.
feature.name: SETTINGS

feature.description:
`files.get`, `files.read`, `files.put`, and GetMessageRFC2822Task's file-id mode (no
`filepath`: the export becomes the File `fileId`, set by the local phase).
feature.name: FILES

feature.description:
The engine acts on due `send-later`, `thread-snooze` and `send-reminders` metadata
itself; only `send-later` rows marked
`clientFinalize`, and other plugins' rows, still come as `metadata-expiration` deltas
for a client to act on.
feature.name: EXPIRATION_EXECUTOR

feature.description: `threads.snooze` and `threads.unsnooze`.
feature.name: SNOOZE

feature.description: `messages.unsubscribe`.
feature.name: UNSUBSCRIBE

feature.description:
`serve`: `draft.create`, `draft.send` (with `bodies` kept with the pending send),
`draft.cancelSend` and `draft.validate`, and the `composing.quoteTexts` setting.
feature.name: DRAFT_PIPELINE

feature.description: `serve`: `draft.update`, `draft.delete`, and `attach` on `draft.create`.
feature.name: DRAFT_EDITING

feature.description:
`serve`: `templates.list|get|save|delete`, `template` on `draft.create`, and the
`template-variable` warning of `draft.validate`.
feature.name: TEMPLATES

feature.description:
`warnings` (`MessageWarning`) on the Message JSON of
`messages.get` and `threads.get`, left out when there are none.
feature.name: MESSAGE_WARNINGS

feature.description:
`draft.send` and the expiration executor send drafts with `open-tracking` or
`link-tracking` on tracked, in the Tern URL format, when the connected server offers
tracking (`capabilities.server.readReceipts` / `linkTracking`); the executor claims due
rows on the server first (docs/backend-plan.md 3.6, 3.8). Clients don't transform
tracked drafts themselves.
feature.name: TRACKING

feature.description: The `integrations.*` methods.
feature.name: INTEGRATIONS

feature.description:
`capabilities` in `hello` and `engine.status`, and `capabilities.changed`
(`Capabilities`).
feature.name: CAPABILITIES

feature.description: The `ai.*` methods but triage, `ai.delta`, and `capabilities.ai`.
feature.name: AI

feature.description:
The engine owns the accounts: the registry
(`accounts.json`) and secret store behind `account.add` and `account.remove` (which
unregisters and deletes the secrets), accounts started at launch, rotated tokens
stored instead of sent, the restart policy (`retryAt`, `authFailed`),
`credentials.import`, `account.changed`, and `credentials`, `build` and `detached` in
`hello`.
feature.name: ACCOUNTS

feature.description:
Triage: the per-account triage of new inbox mail,
`ai.triage.run`, `ai.triage.list`, `ai.triage.progress`, `capabilities.ai.triage`, and
the `core.ai.*` settings keys.
feature.name: AI_TRIAGE

feature.description:
AI providers' keys in the secret store: stored providers read
`integration:ai-<id>`, the AI calls take `provider` without a key, and a stored
provider's key goes when `settings.set` removes the provider or points it at another
kind or server.
feature.name: AI_KEYS

feature.description:
Account setup on the socket: `account.discover`,
`account.oauth.begin|complete`, `account.add` and `account.test` with `secrets`,
`account.setSecrets`, `account.update`, `account.reorder`, `account.remove {revoke,
deleteData}`, `account.reset`, `secrets.*` and `server.*`; ids derived by the engine;
`integrations.*` read a missing key from the secret `integration:<provider>`.
feature.name: ACCOUNT_SETUP

feature.description:
`serve` applies the `mailRules` setting to arriving mail itself (T12), with
`rules.reprocess`, `rules.cancel`, `rules.progress`, `rules.disabled` and the
`mailRulesAutoSince` setting. Clients that see it stop evaluating rules.
feature.name: RULES

feature.description:
`events.expand`, `events.create`, `events.update` and `events.rsvp`, and
SyncbackEventTask's `restore` (an undo or redo re-sent over the copy stored now).
feature.name: CALENDAR_EDITING

feature.description:
`contacts.get`, `contacts.create`, `contacts.update`, `contacts.import` and
`contacts.export`.
feature.name: CONTACT_EDITING

method.description: Every account the engine holds, with its state.
method.name: ACCOUNT_LIST

method.description:
`serve` mode: register an account, store its secrets and start syncing it
(`AccountAddParams`). On the parent's stdin, and on the
socket of an engine with `feature::ACCOUNT_SETUP`
(local-only class, `policy`).
method.name: ACCOUNT_ADD

method.description:
`serve` mode: stop an account, unregister it and delete its secrets, with `revoke`
also its OAuth grant and with `deleteData` its rows
(`AccountRemoveParams`). Without `deleteData` the rows
stay. Where `account.add` is taken.
method.name: ACCOUNT_REMOVE

method.description:
IMAP and SMTP settings for an address (`AccountDiscoverParams`).
Open to relayed connections; answered out of order (MX and autoconfig lookups).
method.name: ACCOUNT_DISCOVER

method.description:
Starts an OAuth sign-in: the engine keeps the PKCE verifier, `state` and client
secret (`OAuthBeginParams`).
method.name: ACCOUNT_OAUTH_BEGIN

method.description:
Ends it with the redirect's `code` and `state`: exchange, profile, discovery, test,
then the account is stored and started (`OAuthCompleteParams`).
Answered out of order.
method.name: ACCOUNT_OAUTH_COMPLETE

method.description: New credentials for a registered account (`AccountSetSecretsParams`).
method.name: ACCOUNT_SET_SECRETS

method.description:
Changes an account's JSON (`AccountUpdateParams`).
Relayed devices without the admin scope may change only
`ACCOUNT_DISPLAY_FIELDS`.
method.name: ACCOUNT_UPDATE

method.description: The order of `account.list` (`AccountReorderParams`).
method.name: ACCOUNT_REORDER

method.description:
Stores a secret that isn't an account's (`SecretsSetParams`).
There is no `secrets.get`.
method.name: SECRETS_SET

method.description: Which of the named secrets are stored (`SecretsHasParams`).
method.name: SECRETS_HAS

method.description: The Tern server the accounts sync metadata with (`ServerSetParams`).
method.name: SERVER_SET

method.description: Forgets it and its token; accounts sync metadata locally.
method.name: SERVER_CLEAR

method.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only (the socket too on a `--detached` engine): stop
every account, remove the socket files and exit 0.
method.name: ENGINE_SHUTDOWN

method.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: register accounts and store secrets a client
held until now, params
`CredentialsImportParams`.
method.name: CREDENTIALS_IMPORT

method.description:
Notification: an account's registered JSON changed, `params` =
`AccountChangedParams`. Filtered by account, never held
for a later subscriber: a client calls `account.list` after `subscribe`.
method.name: ACCOUNT_CHANGED

method.description:
`serve` mode: check an account's IMAP and SMTP settings, as `--mode test` does
(`AccountTestParams`). The result is that mode's JSON
object, with any rotated refresh token in its `account` on stdin only. Where
`account.add` is taken; answered out of order.
method.name: ACCOUNT_TEST

method.description:
`serve` mode: stop the account if the engine holds it, delete its rows from the
database (`--mode reset`) and start it again from the registry to resync (a client
that adds it again gets ACCOUNT_EXISTS). Where `account.add` is taken; answered out of
order.
method.name: ACCOUNT_RESET

method.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: stop and forget every account, delete the
database and create an empty one. The client adds the accounts again.
method.name: ENGINE_RESET_DATABASE

method.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only: verbose protocol logging until a time, for
every account; running accounts restart to pick it up.
method.name: ENGINE_SET_LOG_LEVEL

method.description: The end of an account's log, or of the engine's own log.
method.name: ENGINE_LOGS_TAIL

method.description:
The stored engine-owned settings (`feature::SETTINGS`),
params `SettingsGetParams`, result
`SettingsValues`.
method.name: SETTINGS_GET

method.description: Stores settings, params `SettingsValues`, result `{}`.
method.name: SETTINGS_SET

method.description:
`serve` mode, the parent's stdin only, debug builds only: stop one account as a
fatal error would (`test-crash` on stdin in `sync` mode).
method.name: TEST_CRASH

method.description: As `TEST_CRASH`, with a panic on the account's `main` thread.
method.name: TEST_PANIC

method.description:
Notification: an account changed state, `params` =
`AccountStateParams`.
method.name: ACCOUNT_STATE

method.description: Notification: one flushed delta, `params` = `DeltaParams`.
method.name: DELTA

method.description:
Notification: the engine is about to close the connection, `params` =
`DisconnectParams`.
method.name: DISCONNECT

method.description:
Notification: new mail, `params` = `MailNewParams`. Filtered by
account only, never held for a later subscriber (`feature::MAIL_NEW`).
method.name: MAIL_NEW

method.description:
Notification: settings another connection (or the parent) changed, `params` =
`SettingsValues` with the new values, null for a cleared key.
Sent to every subscribed connection whatever its filter, never held for a later
subscriber: a client calls `settings.get` after `subscribe`.
method.name: SETTINGS_CHANGED

method.description:
The `integrations.*` methods (`feature::INTEGRATIONS`).
Each carries the
provider's `config`, key included, until the engine owns the credentials. Local
clients only, answered out of order on the engine's integrations workers (T21); a
provider failure is `code::INTEGRATION_FAILED`.
method.name: INTEGRATIONS_TRANSLATE

method.description:
Notification: the engine's `capabilities` changed (`feature::CAPABILITIES`),
`params` = the new capabilities object, whole. Sent to every subscribed connection
whatever its filter, never held for a later subscriber: `hello` and `engine.status`
carry the current value.
method.name: CAPABILITIES_CHANGED

method.description:
The `ai.*` methods (`feature::AI`), params and results
in `crate::AiSettings`. Until the engine keeps the AI
settings and keys, local clients send the provider `config`, key included, and the
`settings` with each call; a relayed connection may send neither
(`policy`). Answered out of order on the engine's AI workers (T21);
a failed model call is `code::AI_FAILED`.
method.name: AI_MODELS

method.description: Answered at once, in order: stops the calling connection's stream `streamId`.
method.name: AI_CANCEL

method.description: Token counts per day, provider and feature since the engine started.
method.name: AI_USAGE

method.description: Inbox triage; not served yet.
method.name: AI_TRIAGE_RUN

method.description:
Notification: the next piece of a streamed answer, `params` =
`AiDeltaParams`. Sent only to the connection that started the
stream, in order, without `subscribe`; the call's response comes after the last one
and carries the whole text.
method.name: AI_DELTA

method.description: Notification: triage progress for the connection that called `ai.triage.run`.
method.name: AI_TRIAGE_PROGRESS

method.description:
Mail rules (`feature::RULES`): params and results in
`crate::RulesReprocessParams` and `crate::RulesCancelParams`. The rules themselves
are the `mailRules` setting.
method.name: RULES_REPROCESS

method.description:
Notification: a `rules.reprocess` job's progress, to the connection that started it
only, without `subscribe`; never held.
method.name: RULES_PROGRESS

method.description:
Notification: the engine disabled a failing rule. Sent to every subscribed connection
whatever its filter, never held: the rule's `disabled` and `disabledReason` are saved in
`mailRules`, and `settings.changed` carries them as well.
method.name: RULES_DISABLED

unsubscribe_method.name: ONE_CLICK

unsubscribe_method.description: RFC 2369 `mailto:`: the engine sends the message the URI describes.
unsubscribe_method.name: MAILTO
